note: Adapted from the species-level description in Maiti's monograph on the world species of termites (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; entry no. 156. The original notes that there were no specimens and that the characters are based on Emerson (1925). OCR problem: the head width of the minor soldier is given in the original as '0.65 0.68', with the dash missing, and has been treated here as a range.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Based on 1 female: head reddish yellow, broadly oval, with a few long bristles; lateral and posterior margins forming a regular circular outline. Antennae broken: segment 3 longer than segment 2 or 4, shorter than segment 1, segment 2 almost as long as segment 4. Compound eyes medium-sized, 1.3 mm from the lower margin of the head, oval. Ocelli medium-sized, oval, about their long diameter from the compound eyes. Clypeus projecting in profile, pointed at the apex. Pronotum reddish yellow, with many long bristles; lateral margins and posterior margin forming an almost perfect semicircle, the posterior margin without any concavity. Wing scales and abdomen yellow. Measurements (mm): head length 1.50; head width 1.35; diameter of the compound eye 0.32; pronotum length 0.67; pronotum width 1.06; body length of the female 8.27.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier unknown. Minor soldier: head golden brown, contrasting with the labrum; narrowing slightly behind, the sides therefore concave, widest before the middle, covered with numerous bristles; a tubercle visible at the base of each antenna. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2, the apex of segment 4 slightly inflated, segment 2 equal to segment 4. Labrum very long, thin, forked at the apex, with a median longitudinal groove. Mandibles vestigial but visible as pointed processes beneath the labrum. Pronotum concolorous with the head, widest in the middle, posterior margin not concave, the anterior part elongate, projecting slightly forward as a lobe. Abdomen reddish yellow. Measurements (mm): head length 1.48; head width 0.65—0.68; pronotum length 0.42; pronotum width 0.51.
